standard.summary: 只托管参数量达到该阈值的 Linear/Conv2d。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Only the Linear/Conv2d layers whose parameter count reaches this threshold are managed.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 只托管参数量达到该阈值的 Linear/Conv2d。0 表示全部托管；调高可保留小层在 GPU，减少频繁传输。

advanced_en.principle: Only manages Linear/Conv2d layers whose parameter count reaches this threshold. 0 = manage everything; raising it keeps small layers on the GPU and reduces frequent transfers.
